# region imports
from AlgorithmImports import *
# endregion

class ETFUniverseAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    _universe: List[Symbol] = []
    _momentum: List[MomentumIndicator] = []
    _count = 100
    _top_percent = 0.1

    def initialize(self) -> None:
        self.set_start_date(2022, 1, 1)
        self.set_end_date(2024, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(250000)
        self.settings.seed_initial_prices = True
        self.universe_settings.resolution = Resolution.MINUTE
        self.universe_settings.minimum_order_margin_portfolio_percentage = 0

        def _select(fundamental: List[Fundamental]) -> List[Symbol]:
            # Select the top 100 most liquid ETF constituents by dollar volume
            dollar_volume = {f.symbol: f.dollar_volume for f in fundamental if f.symbol.value.startswith("SPY")}
            self.plot("Universe", "Raw", list(dollar_volume.keys()))
            return [s for s, _ in sorted(dollar_volume.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1])[-self._count:]]

        def _rank(momentum_indicators: List[MomentumIndicator]) -> List[Symbol]:
            # Select the top 10% of the ETF constituents by price momentum
            momentum_by_symbol = {m.symbol: m.current.value for m in momentum_indicators}
            self.plot("Universe", "Momentum", list(momentum_by_symbol.items()))
            return [s for s, _ in sorted(momentum_by_symbol.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1])[-int(len(momentum_by_symbol) * self._top_percent):] ]

        self._universe = _select(self._fundamental)
        self._momentum = [self.momentum(s, 252) for s in self._universe]
        # Warm up the momentum indicators
        for i in range(0, 252):
            self._momentum[i].update(0, 0)

    def on_warmup_finished(self) -> None:
        self._ranked_universe = _rank(self._momentum)
        self.plot("Universe", "Selected", self._ranked_universe)

    def on_date_changed(self, sd: ScheduleDate) -> None:
        if sd.day_of_month == 1 and sd.month == 9:
            self._rebalance()

    def _rebalance(self) -> None:
        selected = [s for s in self._ranked_universe if self.securities[s].has_data]
        if not selected:
            return
        weight = 1 / len(selected)
        targets = [PortfolioTarget(symbol, weight) for symbol in selected]
        self.set_holdings(targets, True)
